# Software lifecycle checklist

1. Software inventory export exists, has a name column and a version column, and has an owner for each row where one is known [[XW-001]] [[XW-002]]
2. Header row confirmed without opening any data row; dates in the export are ISO dates [[XW-026]]
3. Inventory, golden-source, exception, tracking, and support-records files kept out of prompts, issues, and commits [[XW-028]]
4. Tool copy made only with the person's say-so, at the pinned commit, and `git rev-parse HEAD` matched the pin, and the commit recorded [[XW-020]]
5. Bundled data checked with `verify-data`, and the data dates read from the manifest [[XW-026]]
6. `preflight` run and every item on its "What to fix" list handled in the export [[XW-026]]
7. Output folder named by the person, new or empty, and outside the inventory, tool, and working folders [[XW-028]]
8. Check run in counts-only mode, as of a stated date [[XW-009]]
9. Only the summary count lines read; no name, item ID, or report file opened by the agent [[XW-028]]
10. Counts reported by state: past end of life, ends soon, mainstream support ended, supported, unmatched [[XW-009]]
11. Names to review, classification counts, and any support-records line reported with their limits stated [[XW-001]] [[XW-026]]
12. KEV needs-review wording used exactly, with no item called affected or exposed [[XW-024]]
13. Each past-end-of-life or ends-soon item given an owner decision: replace, upgrade, retire, or request risk acceptance [[XW-009]] [[XW-010]] [[XW-024]]
14. Upgrade or replacement cost handed to the owner as a budget input, not estimated by the agent [[XW-012]]
15. Dates-disagree items settled by the ITAM lead [[XW-026]]
16. Count line, data dates, and decisions kept as dated evidence, with no names or IDs in it [[XW-020]]
17. Review repeated on the person's schedule, and the previous report passed to the tool by path [[XW-025]]
